on_chain.about: The fee knos_pay takes at release, jobs and orders alike: max(0.05, floor(amount x 30 / 10,000)) in the token's base units (six decimals). One rate, no tiers, no cap.

years.name: the worked customer: Business, 110,000 evaluations a month, 10 million accepted a year, none released on chain
inside the free allowance, no plan: nothing
Team, 2 million accepted a month: the second million pays 0.20%
the same value with no contract: 0.30% of all of it
years.how: Meter 3,600. Acceptance 24,000,000 x 0.30% = 72,000. The volume rates are by contract.

years.name: Enterprise, 20 million a month, half of it released on chain, 100 lookups a month
years.how: Meter 900,000 x 0.002 x 12 = 21,600. A month's 20,000,000 at the volume rates: 3,000 + 18,000 + 10,000 = 31,000. The 10,000,000 released on chain lies first: 3,000 + 18,000 = 21,000 at the volume rates, and it paid 30,000 on chain, so 9,000 a month is rebated: 108,000 a year. The 10,000,000 reconciled off chain lies above it: 10,000 a month, 120,000 a year. Lookups 100 x 0.25 x 12 = 300. 400,000 + 21,600 + 120,000 + 300 - 108,000 = 433,900.

years.name: everything released on chain: the fee was paid there and is never on the invoice
years.how: 6,000,000 x 0.30% = 18,000 was paid to the program at release. 500,000 a month earns no volume rate. The invoice is Control.

months.name: the worked customer's first month: 40 deliverables of 20,000
months.how: Control 100,000 / 12 = 8,333.33. Meter 10,000 x 0.002 = 20. Acceptance 40 x 60 = 2,400. Five suppliers connected: nothing.

months.name: the tiers inside one month, with value released on chain lying first
the floor: 0.05 a deliverable, and nothing for no value
no cap: one deliverable of 4,000,000 with no contract
released on chain above the first million: the volume rebate is a credit
months.how: The program took 3,000,000 x 0.30% = 9,000. At the volume rates it is 3,000 + 2,000,000 x 0.20% = 7,000. The 2,000 between them is credited against Control's 8,333.33.

margin.about: The worked customer's first month at docs/unit_costs.json: Control 8,333.33 against 15,000 / 12 = 1,250; Meter 20 against 110,000 x 0.0002 = 22 (the free 100,000 cost something too); Acceptance 2,400 against 40 x 0.10 = 4.
